note: Hand-authored corpus for the search-similarity curve. Observations are memory records; queries are retrieval requests. Relevance is intentional, not derived from lexical overlap, so paraphrase pairs land near the relevance floor.

observations.title: Fixed OrderQuery.pageOffset off-by-one in pagination
observations.narrative: OrderQuery.pageOffset now subtracts one from the requested page before multiplying by pageSize; page 1 starts at index 0.

observations.title: Clamped negative page numbers in PageRequest
observations.narrative: PageRequest.normalizePage maps page <= 0 to 1 before building the offset.

observations.title: Fixed UserCache computeIfAbsent race
observations.narrative: UserCache.get now performs the load inside computeIfAbsent so concurrent callers share one value.
facts: CacheConcurrencyTest#reads returns one instance for 8 threads

observations.title: Evicted stale entries after 10 minutes in SessionCache
observations.narrative: SessionCache.expireAfterWrite is 10 minutes and eviction runs on access.
facts: SessionCacheTest#staleEntryIsReloaded asserts a reload after 11 minutes

observations.title: Fixed login timestamp timezone regression
observations.narrative: LoginAudit.timestamp now writes UTC and formats Asia/Shanghai at render time.

observations.title: Removed legacy-search feature flag
observations.narrative: FeatureFlags.LEGACY_SEARCH was deleted; SearchService no longer branches on it.
facts: SearchService.search has a single code path

observations.title: Redacted session tokens from ingest logs
observations.narrative: IngestController masks the Authorization header before logging.
facts: IngestControllerTest#logHasNoToken asserts the token is absent

observations.title: Hardened observation search against SQL injection
observations.narrative: ObservationRepository uses parameterized queries for project and query text.

observations.title: Enabled canary rollback at 5% error rate
observations.narrative: The rollout pipeline rolls back when canary.errorRate exceeds 5%.
facts: rollback.sh exits 1 when the threshold is exceeded

observations.title: Added healthcheck to backend Dockerfile
observations.narrative: The backend image probes /api/health every 30 seconds with a 3 second timeout.

observations.title: Set MCP client timeout to 30 seconds
observations.narrative: McpClient.requestTimeout is 30 seconds and a timeout returns McpTimeoutException.
